config.subject_selection: minimum SHA256(group_seed, source, subject_id) among complete eligible groups; fixed across seeds
config.item_selection: all distinct items in the selected 80-1000-item group; no truncation
config.split: seeded SHA256 item ordering; first ceil(N/2) acquisition, remaining floor(N/2) evaluation
config.response_selection: lowest (trial, response_id) binary response per subject/item, fixed across policies and seeds
config.random_acquisition: deterministic uniform stream: u < labels_remaining / items_remaining
